faq.q: Is East Delta an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. The City of Delta plans the city as Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta, and "East Delta" is a Paragon sub-area name for the rural farm area east of Ladner, covered by the municipal-wide OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024); the urban part was formerly under the East Ladner Area Plan (Schedule B.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950), which Bylaw No. 8400 consolidated away.

faq.q: Can a farm parcel in East Delta have a second dwelling?
faq.a: Under Agricultural Land Commission rules, an ALR parcel may have one principal residence plus, in some cases, one additional detached residence up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on larger parcels; Delta zoning also allows one accessory farm dwelling unit in the A1 zone within those size limits.

faq.q: What is the smallest new farm lot that can be created in the A1 zone?
faq.a: Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 10.10.8, sets the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision in the A1 zone at 8 ha, subject to OCP compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable.

Catchments are address-based in School District 37 (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12, no middle tier) and no sample-address result is published for this sub-area — check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator.

faq.q: Is East Delta behind dykes or in a floodplain?
faq.a: Delta's low farm land is protected by dykes, and the City lists flood protection requirements among the checks that apply to development; the City is raising sections of the Boundary Bay dike between 72 Street and 88 Street with provincial grant funding — confirm the requirement for a specific lot with the City.
